description: Use this when the person asks what's on today or how today's session is going, and before logging a set. Reads today's session (or the next one) in their Almost Fire account with every exercise, its target and the sets logged, this week's sessions and training volume, and their food and weight so far today. Do not use for another day's session; use get_schedule and get_session.
name: get_today
title: Today
